rights_review.scope: Public redistribution through GitHub Pages, repository downloads, and an API

evidence.observation: The Materials section describes the 30 passages as previously employed in Eiken Tests, not as prose authored by the TECO researchers. The acknowledgement names JSPS funding but no Eiken permission or downstream reuse terms.
The README lists full reading passages and general disclaimers but no Eiken permission, exclusion, sublicense, or downstream redistribution statement.
The 34-page file contains the Eiken-labelled passage and comprehension-question text but no copyright, permission, attribution, Creative Commons, or redistribution notice.

evidence.source: TECO OSF node and CC BY 4.0 terms
evidence.observation: The node is set to CC BY 4.0, which grants only copyright and similar rights that the licensor has authority to license; that setting alone does not establish authority over third-party Eiken prose.

The current public terms claim rights in past-test content, prohibit unauthorized public copying, and direct researchers to obtain permission. These current terms do not prove what private permission, if any, the TECO team received earlier.

exclude: Reading Matarials.pdf and Reading Proficiency Test.pdf
ordered ia, lemma, or other surface/token sequences capable of reconstructing a passage
may_publish: stable source IDs and positions without surface tokens
derived results that are non-reconstructive and separately pass participant-data review

decision_change_requires: written evidence covering the identified 30 passages and questions
permission for public repository, GitHub Pages, download, and API redistribution
permission for downstream reuse, transformation, tokenization, and information analysis
commercial-use and CC BY compatibility or an explicitly narrower segregated release
term, territory, attribution, modification, and any upstream third-party-rights conditions
rights_review.caveat: No public permission record was located. This is not a finding that no private or historical permission exists, and it is not legal advice.

project_role.reentry_gate: Core benchmark frozen, separate hypothesis justified, artifact-level rights and participant-data review passed, and analysis plan frozen before any outcome join.

admitted_role_if_rights_check_passes: exploratory moderation by general reading proficiency
forbidden_inferences: eye movement proves contextual MWE knowledge
general reading proficiency equals P_word or P_mwe_sense
screen-level attention checks are automatically global comprehension
TECO results transfer to Project Gutenberg or all L2 readers
the OSF project license alone proves the underlying Eiken passages may be redistributed
next_action: Continue core benchmark work without waiting for TECO correspondence. Archive any author response for possible later re-entry; do not publish Eiken text or reconstructable token sequences, and keep any future TECO outcome join local and separately gated for participant-data review.
